source.original_question:
As shown in the figure, Xiaoming designed two right angles to measure the width of the river BC, then the width of the river BC is ()
Choices:
A:\frac{7}{2}m
B:\frac{17}{2}m
C:\frac{40}{7}m
D:11m

independent_solution.method: Right trianglesABD andACE are similar:AC/AB=CE/BD=9/(7/3)=27/7. ThereforeAC=54/7 andBC=54/7-2=40/7m.
